senses.definition: n.pr.m. (salvation; on form, cf. הַשְׁמֵד, הַמְשֵׁל; on pronunciation v. HptZA ii, 261 Anm. 2 JägerBAS i, 468)—
orig. name of Joshua according to Nu 13:8, 16 (P), 𝔊 Αυση, cf. Dt 32:44 (J; prob. error, v. Dr), 𝔊 Ιησους, v. יְהוֹשׁוּעַ p. 221 supr.
last king of Israel 2 K 15:30; 17:1, 3, 4, 6; 18:1, 9, 10, 𝔊 Ωσηε.
the prophet Hosea Ho 1:1, 2(×2), 𝔊 Ωσηε.
an Ephraimite chief under David 1 Ch 27:20, 𝔊 Ωση(ε).
a chief under Nehemiah Ne 10:24, 𝔊 Ωσηθα, Ωσηε.
